notice:
Chinese course (≈ HSK 1–4), written for qinqin and released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Credit: qinqin contributors, CC BY 4.0, [the qinqin repository](https://github.com/Elaktrato/qinqin).

The course holds the skeleton (sections, units, themes, the placement of the zh-grammar lessons, the characters each unit introduces, checkpoints) and the reading texts with their translations. It contains no level-list words: each server fills the units from its installed `hsk-words` level list, so the words follow that list's licence. The levels are qinqin's estimates ("≈ HSK 1" to "≈ HSK 4"), not official levels; the order is qinqin's own, not taken from a textbook or syllabus.

The texts and the skeleton were reviewed by agents acting as native-speaker teachers, not yet by a person; corrections are welcome.
